SwimmermCharlieSeenText:
The water's warm
here. I'm loose and limber.

Sure, I'll take
you on!
SwimmermCharlieAfterBattleText:
Isn't it relaxing
just floating like this?
SwimmermGeorgeSeenText:
I'm a bit tired.
If I win, lend me your #MON.
SwimmermGeorgeAfterBattleText:
It's so far to
CIANWOOD.

But it's no easy
return trip to OLIVINE either.

What should I do?
SwimmermBerkeSeenText:
See those islands
that are blocked by whirlpools?

There just has to
be a secret!
SwimmermBerkeBeatenText:
What's the secret
to your strength?
SwimmermBerkeAfterBattleText:
It was a dark and
stormy night…

I saw this giant
#MON flying from the islands.

It was scattering
feathers from its silver wings.
SwimmermKirkSeenText:
The waves are wild
here.

They tire you out
while you swim.
SwimmermKirkAfterBattleText:
The currents keep
me from reaching that island.
SwimmermMathewSeenText:
Are you seeking
the secrets of WHIRL ISLANDS?
SwimmermMathewAfterBattleText:
A secret about
WHIRL ISLANDS…

It's pitch-black
inside!
SwimmerfKayleeSeenText:
I'm on my way to
WHIRL ISLANDS.

I'm going explor-
ing with friends.
SwimmerfKayleeBeatenText:
Is that how you do
it?
SwimmerfKayleeAfterBattleText:
There's supposed
to be a big #- MON deep beneath WHIRL ISLANDS.

I wonder what it
could be?
SwimmerfSusieSeenText:
You look so ele-
gant, riding your #MON.
SwimmerfSusieAfterBattleText:
Wasn't there a hit
song about a boy riding a LAPRAS?
SwimmerfDeniseSeenText:
The weather is so
beautiful, I'm in a daze!
SwimmerfDeniseAfterBattleText:
A sunburn is the
worst for skin.

But I don't use a
sunblock.

I won't pollute
the water.
SwimmerfKaraSeenText:
If you need to
rest, just tread water.

You'll get your
wind back, so you

can keep on going
strong.
SwimmerfKaraBeatenText:
Oh! You have more
energy than I do.
SwimmerfKaraAfterBattleText:
I heard roars from
deep inside the ISLANDS.
SwimmerfWendySeenText:
At night, STARYU
gather near the water's surface.
SwimmerfWendyAfterBattleText:
The clusters of
STARYU light up at the same time.

It's so beautiful,
it's scary.
